messages:
sara: Heads-up — us-west-2b AZ showing lots of tail latency on inference requests and ~30 GPU nodes stuck in provisioning. Logs show repeated KMS timeouts around the same window. :eyes:
raj: Is this the KMS audit sampler spike we saw in staging last week?
cheng: Yep. The audit sampler suddenly pumped ~3x requests to KMS for each node boot (cloudtrail replay + higher sampling), which in turn increased NAT egress and conntrack usage. NAT gw conntrack is hitting the limit and new node handshakes are dropping.
elena: ugh. Any quick evidence? can you paste the relevant logs?
sara: paste: ```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z provisioner[pool-gpu]: KMSDecrypt start id=abc123 retry=0
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z net: conntrack: table full, dropping packet src=10.1.2.3:43210 dst=54.239.23.12:443
2026-03-20T09:12:08Z provisioner[pool-gpu]: KMSDecrypt timeout id=abc123 err=504
```
cheng: exact sequence. Firewall didn't block anything; it's resource exhaustion on the NAT + bursty audit traffic to KMS endpoints. Security sampling policy changed (higher fidelity for a region) and that went into effect this morning.
raj: Can we reduce sampling for that region immediately? who can flip it? @security-bot any fast rollback?
security-bot: @raj I've escalated to security-config. Policy rollback is allowed but requires a 15m audit note. Do we want to reduce sampling to baseline (0.1) or pause for the AZ (0.0)?
elena: baseline then evaluate — but we also need a short-term infra workaround. If we pause sampling entirely we lose audit fidelity and might need to explain to compliance.
sara: short term plan proposal: 1) increase conntrack max on NAT gateways (sysctl) for the warm pool nodes, 2) create a small route rule to prefer us-west-2a for new boot requests, 3) reduce sampling to baseline for 1h while we stabilize. Thoughts?
cheng: conntrack bump: sysctl example for proxy hosts: ```sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144 && echo 262144 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max``` that helps immediately but NAT gw (managed) has limits — might need to spin up an extra NAT instance in the AZ or enable additional concurrency on the managed NAT.
raj: Cost call: spinning an extra NAT or enabling additional managed throughput will add ~$0.12/hr + egress cost delta; compared to customer impact from throttled inference. I'm +1 on temporary NAT and conntrack bump.
elena: Also propose a medium term: put a regional KMS proxy/cache (small fleet) in front of KMS for node boots to dramatically reduce per-node KMS calls (cache decrypted wrapping keys for 10m). That reduces audit load while preserving KMS usage patterns. Will need security signoff.
security-bot: Note: caching decrypted material is sensitive. Any proxy must not persist plaintext keys, must use envelope keys and be HSM-backed. We can approve a short-lived cache design with strict TTL and logging.
sara: immediate actions done: bumped conntrack on the affected warm-pool jumpers, spun up 1 extra NAT instance in us-west-2b, and routed new boots to us-west-2a for the next 30m. Lowered sampling to baseline for 1h (security noted). Observing.
ops-bot: autoscaler: paused scale-up for pool-gpu-usw2b due to provisioning failures (action taken by @sara). Ticket INF-5421 created and assigned to @cheng.
cheng: watching metrics — provisioning success rate creeping up to 96% since actions. Node boot retries dropped from median 4 -> 1.
raj: please confirm cost estimate for the NAT + increased conntrack (and sampling rollback impact). We need to record for a postmortem.
elena: quick calc: extra NAT instance ~ $0.14/hr, conntrack sysctl no cost, 1h sampling rollback reduces audit logs by ~30% saving maybe $2-5 for the hour (S3+ingest), but medium-term proxy dev cost will dominate.
sara: agreed. Postmortem planned. Next steps: 1) schedule design doc for regional KMS proxy, 2) short runbook to bump conntrack + spin NAT as temp mitigation, 3) tighten sampling rollout checks.
security-bot: I'll add compliance constraints to the design doc template. Also recommend a canary of sampling changes (10% of region) before global flips.
raj: thanks all — if stability holds we'll revert the extra NAT at 13:00 UTC and restore normal sampling.
elena: ack. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INF-5421 updated: status=investigating assignee=cheng priority=high components=[kms,networking,gpu-provisioning]
